title: INDIA Bloc Calls Citizens to Supreme Court March on October 12
detail: Rahul Gandhi urged citizens to join the INDIA bloc's Supreme Court march as Indians regardless of party affiliation, broadening the protest coalition ahead of the October 12 demonstration to submit a memorandum to the Chief Justice of India.

media.caption: INDIA bloc announces protest march to the Supreme Court on October 12

title: Supreme Court Mandates Free Movement, Bars Illegal Detentions
detail: India's Supreme Court mandated free movement and barred illegal detention, with lawyers citing Emergency-era parallels — a direct legal intervention in the ongoing protest crackdown on youth demonstrators.

media.caption: Supreme Court bars illegal detentions amid protest crackdown
